summary.text: Mumbai won by 10 wkts. MUM 1st Innings made 430-10, Angkrish Raghuvanshi top-scoring with 114 off 180 balls; Samant Jakhar took 3 for 41. HAR 2nd Innings made 256-10 f/o, Himanshu Rana top-scoring with 46 off 62 balls; Tanush Kotian took 8 for 81. MUM 2nd Innings made 97-0, Angkrish Raghuvanshi top-scoring with 67 off 39 balls.
